subject: Cant extract ID from ActiGraph csv file so failed to use sleeplog

messages.author: b2589c81f4bbd91c
messages.subject: Cant extract ID from ActiGraph csv file so failed to use sleeplog
parts:
Dear Vincent,
  I'm using GGIR 2.7-1  to analyze my ActiGraph csv data (14 days of monitoring). However, as we know, the file's header doesn't have the participant ID, so the sleeplog id can't match with the participant ID. In consequence, I failed to use the sleeplog to analyze the sleep part.
  Is there any way to solve this problem?

Here is my code:

mode = c(1,2,3,4,5)
datadir = "E:/mystudy/mydata/BPM123.csv"
outputdir = "E:/results"
studyname ="BPM123"
f0 = 1
f1 = 2
GGIR(#-------------------------------
     # General parameters
     #-------------------------------
     mode = mode,
     datadir = datadir,
     outputdir = outputdir,
     studyname = studyname,
     f0 = f0,
     f1 = f1,na.rm = TRUE,
     overwrite = FALSE,
     do.imp = TRUE,
     print.filename = FALSE,
     storefolderstructure = FALSE,
     rmc.headername.recordingid = NULL,
     #-------------------------------
     # Part 1 parameters:
     #-------------------------------
     windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),
     do.cal = TRUE,
     do.enmo = TRUE,
     do.anglez = TRUE,
     chunksize = 1,
     printsummary = TRUE,
     #-------------------------------
     # Part 2 parameters:
     #-------------------------------
     strategy = 1,
     hrs.del.start = 1,
     hrs.del.end = 1,
     maxdur = 0,
     includedaycrit = 16,
     M5L5res = 10,
     winhr = c(5,10),
     qwindow = c(0,24),
     mvpathreshold = c(100,120),
     #-------------------------------
     # Part 3 parameters:
     #-------------------------------
     timethreshold = 5,
     anglethreshold = 5,
     ignorenonwear = TRUE,
     #-------------------------------
     # Part 4 parameters:
     #-------------------------------
     excludefirstlast = FALSE,
     includenightcrit = 16,
     nnights = 14,
     loglocation = "E:/mystudy/sleepdiary/sleeplog.csv",
     outliers.only = FALSE,
     relyonguider = FALSE,
     colid = 1,
     coln1 = 2,
     do.visual = TRUE,
     sleeplogidnum = FALSE,
     #-------------------------------
     # Part 5 parameters:
     #-------------------------------
     # Key functions: Merging physical activity with sleep analyses
     threshold.lig = c(30,40,50),
     threshold.mod = c(100,120),
     threshold.vig = c(400,500),
     boutcriter = 0.8,
     boutcriter.in = 0.9,
     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
     boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,
     boutdur.in = c(10,20,30),
     boutdur.lig = c(1,5,10),
     boutdur.mvpa = c(1,5,10),
     timewindow = c("WW"),
     #-----------------------------------
     # Report generation
     #-------------------------------
     do.report = c(2,4,5))

Best,
Chan

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Cant extract ID from ActiGraph csv file so failed to use sleeplog
parts:
Hi,

Please see the documentation for argument idloc, which allows you to extract the ID from the file names.

Best,
Jairo

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Cant extract ID from ActiGraph csv file so failed to use sleeplog
parts:
Hi,

Keep reading, if ID is not in the file header, then idloc = 1 (default) would not work. In that case, set idloc as either 2, 5, 6, or 7, depending on how your file names look like.

Best,
Jairo
